subject: Life Sciences
title: Grade 11 Life Sciences Paper 1: Mock Exam

questions.scenario: Various options are given as possible answers to the following questions. Choose the correct answer.
questions.scenarioAf: Verskeie opsies word as moontlike antwoorde vir die volgende vrae gegee. Kies die korrekte antwoord.

questions.q: Mushrooms and moulds belong to the …
questions.qAf: Sampioene en skimmels behoort tot die …

questions.q: Tuberculosis (TB) is caused by a …
questions.qAf: Tuberkulose (TB) word veroorsaak deur ’n …

questions.q: HIV attacks the …
questions.qAf: MIV val die … aan.

questions.q: Plants that have flowers and seeds enclosed in fruits are …
questions.qAf: Plante wat blomme en sade in vrugte ingesluit het, is …

questions.q: The fusion of a male gamete with an egg cell in a plant is called …
questions.qAf: Die versmelting van ’n manlike gameet met ’n eiersel in ’n plant word … genoem.

questions.q: Which animal has radial symmetry?
questions.qAf: Watter dier het radiale simmetrie?

questions.q: Which animal has no true tissues?
questions.qAf: Watter dier het geen ware weefsels nie?

questions.q: The raw materials for photosynthesis are …
questions.qAf: Die grondstowwe vir fotosintese is …

questions.q: Bile is produced by the …
questions.qAf: Gal word geproduseer deur die …

questions.q: The teeth that carnivores use to slice through flesh are the …
questions.qAf: Die tande wat karnivore gebruik om deur vleis te sny, is die …

questions.scenario: Give the correct biological term for each of the following descriptions.
questions.scenarioAf: Gee die korrekte biologiese term vir elk van die volgende beskrywings.

questions.q: Micro-organisms that can reproduce only inside living cells
questions.qAf: Mikro-organismes wat slegs binne lewende selle kan voortplant

questions.q: Proteins made by white blood cells that act against specific antigens
questions.qAf: Proteïene wat deur witbloedselle gemaak word en teen spesifieke antigene optree

questions.q: The part of the stamen that produces pollen
questions.qAf: Die deel van die meeldraad wat stuifmeel produseer

questions.q: The generation in a plant life cycle that produces spores
questions.qAf: Die generasie in ’n plantlewensiklus wat spore produseer

questions.q: The splitting of water molecules by light energy during photosynthesis
questions.qAf: Die splitsing van watermolekules deur ligenergie tydens fotosintese

questions.q: Taking food into the mouth
questions.qAf: Die neem van voedsel in die mond

questions.q: Wave-like muscle contractions that move food along the gut
questions.qAf: Golfagtige spiersametrekkings wat voedsel deur die spysverteringskanaal beweeg

questions.q: The concentration of sense organs and nerve tissue at the front end of an animal
questions.qAf: Die konsentrasie van sintuie en senuweefsel aan die voorkant van ’n dier

questions.scenario: Indicate whether each of the descriptions applies to A ONLY, B ONLY, BOTH A AND B or NONE of the items.
questions.scenarioAf: Dui aan of elk van die beskrywings op SLEGS A, SLEGS B, BEIDE A EN B of GEEN van die items van toepassing is.

questions.q:
Produce seeds
A: gymnosperms B: angiosperms
questions.qAf:
Produseer sade
A: gimnosperme B: angiosperme

questions.q:
Happens in the dark phase of photosynthesis
A: carbon dioxide is built into glucose B: water is split
questions.qAf:
Gebeur in die donkerfase van fotosintese
A: koolstofdioksied word in glukose ingebou B: water word gesplits

questions.q:
Secreted by the pancreas
A: lipase B: bile
questions.qAf:
Word deur die pankreas afgeskei
A: lipase B: gal

questions.q:
Caused by a virus
A: malaria B: influenza
questions.qAf:
Word deur ’n virus veroorsaak
A: malaria B: griep

questions.scenario: Pondweed was placed in water containing different concentrations of sodium hydrogen carbonate, which releases carbon dioxide. The lamp was kept at the same distance and the bubbles released per minute were counted.
questions.scenarioAf: Damplant is in water met verskillende konsentrasies natriumwaterstofkarbonaat geplaas, wat koolstofdioksied vrystel. Die lamp is op dieselfde afstand gehou en die borrels wat per minuut vrygestel is, is getel.

questions.q: Identify the independent variable.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die onafhanklike veranderlike.
points: the carbon dioxide concentration (concentration of sodium hydrogen carbonate)
pointsAf: die koolstofdioksiedkonsentrasie (konsentrasie natriumwaterstofkarbonaat)

questions.q: Identify the dependent variable.
questions.qAf: Identifiseer die afhanklike veranderlike.
points: the number of bubbles per minute (rate of photosynthesis)
pointsAf: die aantal borrels per minuut (tempo van fotosintese)

questions.q: Name the gas in the bubbles.
questions.qAf: Noem die gas in die borrels.
points: oxygen
pointsAf: suurstof

questions.q: Describe the trend shown by the results.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die neiging wat die resultate toon.
points: As the carbon dioxide concentration increases, the rate of photosynthesis increases
and then levels off above about 1,5%
pointsAf: Soos die koolstofdioksiedkonsentrasie toeneem, neem die tempo van fotosintese toe
en plat dan af bo ongeveer 1,5%

questions.q: Explain why the rate levels off at high concentrations.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom die tempo by hoë konsentrasies afplat.
points: Carbon dioxide is no longer the limiting factor
another factor, such as light intensity or temperature, now limits the rate
pointsAf: Koolstofdioksied is nie meer die beperkende faktor nie
’n ander faktor, soos ligintensiteit of temperatuur, beperk nou die tempo

questions.q: Draw a line graph of the results.
questions.qAf: Teken ’n lyngrafiek van die resultate.
points: Correct type of graph (line graph)
Caption that names both variables
x-axis: concentration of sodium hydrogen carbonate (%) with a suitable scale
y-axis: number of bubbles per minute with a suitable scale
All points plotted correctly
pointsAf: Korrekte soort grafiek (lyngrafiek)
Opskrif wat albei veranderlikes noem
x-as: konsentrasie natriumwaterstofkarbonaat (%) met ’n geskikte skaal
y-as: aantal borrels per minuut met ’n geskikte skaal
Al die punte korrek gestip

questions.q: Name ONE variable that was kept constant.
questions.qAf: Noem EEN veranderlike wat konstant gehou is.
points: light intensity (the distance of the lamp), temperature, or the same plant
pointsAf: ligintensiteit (die afstand van die lamp), temperatuur, of dieselfde plant

questions.q: How could the reliability of the results be improved?
questions.qAf: Hoe kon die betroubaarheid van die resultate verbeter word?
points: Repeat each concentration several times and calculate an average
pointsAf: Herhaal elke konsentrasie ’n paar keer en bereken ’n gemiddelde

questions.q: Describe the structure of a virus.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die struktuur van ’n virus.
points: A protein coat
surrounding a core of nucleic acid (DNA or RNA)
pointsAf: ’n Proteïenmantel
wat ’n kern van nukleïensuur (DNS of RNS) omring

questions.q: Give TWO harmful effects of fungi.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE skadelike gevolge van swamme.
points: They cause diseases such as athlete’s foot or thrush
they spoil food or damage crops
pointsAf: Hulle veroorsaak siektes soos voetskimmel of sproei
hulle bederf voedsel of beskadig gewasse

questions.q: Name the vector of malaria and give TWO ways to prevent the disease.
questions.qAf: Noem die vektor van malaria en gee TWEE maniere om die siekte te voorkom.
points: the female Anopheles mosquito
sleeping under mosquito nets
insect repellents or insecticides, or removing standing water
pointsAf: die wyfie-Anopheles-muskiet
onder muskietnette slaap
insekafweermiddels of insekdoders, of die verwydering van staande water

questions.q: Explain how bacteria become resistant to an antibiotic.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe bakterieë weerstandig teen ’n antibiotikum word.
points: A random mutation makes a few bacteria resistant
the antibiotic kills the bacteria that are not resistant
the resistant bacteria survive and reproduce, so the resistant population grows
pointsAf: ’n Lukrake mutasie maak ’n paar bakterieë weerstandig
die antibiotikum maak die bakterieë dood wat nie weerstandig is nie
die weerstandige bakterieë oorleef en plant voort, dus groei die weerstandige bevolking

questions.q: Give TWO ways in which micro-organisms are used in biotechnology.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE maniere waarop mikro-organismes in biotegnologie gebruik word.
points: bacteria are used to make insulin or other medicines
yeast is used to make bread and beer
pointsAf: bakterieë word gebruik om insulien of ander medisyne te maak
gis word gebruik om brood en bier te maak

questions.q: Distinguish between natural and artificial immunity.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen natuurlike en kunsmatige immuniteit.
points: Natural immunity develops after having the disease, or from antibodies received from the mother
artificial immunity is gained from a vaccine
pointsAf: Natuurlike immuniteit ontwikkel nadat die siekte opgedoen is, of uit teenliggaampies wat van die moeder ontvang is
kunsmatige immuniteit word uit ’n entstof verkry

questions.q: Tabulate TWO differences between gymnosperms and angiosperms.
questions.qAf: Tabuleer TWEE verskille tussen gimnosperme en angiosperme.
points: Gymnosperms: naked seeds, usually in cones / Angiosperms: seeds enclosed in a fruit
Gymnosperms: no flowers / Angiosperms: have flowers
pointsAf: Gimnosperme: naakte sade, gewoonlik in keëls / Angiosperme: sade in ’n vrug ingesluit
Gimnosperme: geen blomme nie / Angiosperme: het blomme

questions.q: Explain why ferns can grow much taller than mosses.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom varings baie hoër as mosse kan groei.
points: Ferns have vascular tissue that transports water and food
and gives support
pointsAf: Varings het vaatweefsel wat water en voedsel vervoer
en ondersteuning gee

questions.q: State the function of a spore.
questions.qAf: Noem die funksie van ’n spoor.
points: Asexual reproduction and dispersal
pointsAf: Ongeslagtelike voortplanting en verspreiding

questions.q: Give TWO adaptations of plants for life on land.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE aanpassings van plante vir lewe op land.
points: a waxy cuticle that reduces water loss
stomata, roots or vascular tissue
pointsAf: ’n wasagtige kutikula wat waterverlies verminder
huidmondjies, wortels of vaatweefsel

questions.q: Give TWO reasons why plants are important in ecosystems.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE redes waarom plante belangrik in ekosisteme is.
points: They are producers that provide food for other organisms
they release oxygen, provide habitats, or protect the soil
pointsAf: Hulle is produsente wat voedsel vir ander organismes verskaf
hulle stel suurstof vry, bied habitatte, of beskerm die grond

questions.q: Which division of plants is the most diverse today?
questions.qAf: Watter afdeling van plante is vandag die mees diverse?
points: angiosperms
pointsAf: angiosperme

questions.q: State the function of each of the following parts of a flower: (a) anther, (b) stigma, (c) ovary, (d) petals.
questions.qAf: Noem die funksie van elk van die volgende dele van ’n blom: (a) helmknop, (b) stempel, (c) vrugbeginsel, (d) kroonblare.
points: (a) produces pollen
(b) receives pollen
(c) contains the ovules and develops into the fruit
(d) attract insects (pollinators)
pointsAf: (a) produseer stuifmeel
(b) ontvang stuifmeel
(c) bevat die saadknoppe en ontwikkel tot die vrug
(d) lok insekte (bestuiwers)

questions.q: Distinguish between self-pollination and cross-pollination.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen selfbestuiwing en kruisbestuiwing.
points: Self-pollination: pollen is transferred to a stigma of the same flower or plant
cross-pollination: pollen is transferred to a stigma of a different plant of the same species
pointsAf: Selfbestuiwing: stuifmeel word na ’n stempel van dieselfde blom of plant oorgedra
kruisbestuiwing: stuifmeel word na ’n stempel van ’n ander plant van dieselfde spesie oorgedra

questions.q: Give TWO advantages of cross-pollination.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE voordele van kruisbestuiwing.
points: It produces offspring with more genetic variation
so the species is better able to survive changes in the environment
pointsAf: Dit lewer nakomelinge met meer genetiese variasie
dus is die spesie beter in staat om veranderinge in die omgewing te oorleef

questions.q: Describe TWO methods of seed dispersal and give an example of each.
questions.qAf: Beskryf TWEE metodes van saadverspreiding en gee ’n voorbeeld van elk.
points: Wind: light seeds with wings or hairs
e.g. dandelion or maple
Animals: hooked seeds stick to fur, or fruits are eaten and seeds passed out
e.g. blackjacks or berries
pointsAf: Wind: ligte sade met vlerke of hare
bv. perdeblom of esdoring
Diere: sade met hakies klou aan pels vas, of vrugte word geëet en sade uitgeskei
bv. knapsekêrels of bessies

questions.q: Give TWO advantages of asexual reproduction for farmers.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE voordele van ongeslagtelike voortplanting vir boere.
points: The offspring are identical to a parent with desired characteristics
it is quick and does not need pollinators
pointsAf: Die nakomelinge is identies aan ’n ouer met gewenste eienskappe
dit is vinnig en het nie bestuiwers nodig nie

questions.q: Distinguish between radial and bilateral symmetry.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen radiale en bilaterale simmetrie.
points: Radial: the body can be divided into equal halves along any plane through the centre
bilateral: the body can be divided into two mirror-image halves along one plane only
pointsAf: Radiaal: die liggaam kan langs enige vlak deur die middelpunt in gelyke helftes verdeel word
bilateraal: die liggaam kan slegs langs een vlak in twee spieëlbeeld-helftes verdeel word

questions.q: Name the phylum to which each animal belongs: (a) a sponge with pores in its body wall, (b) an animal with a backbone, (c) a tapeworm, (d) a spider.
questions.qAf: Noem die filum waaraan elke dier behoort: (a) ’n spons met porieë in sy liggaamswand, (b) ’n dier met ’n ruggraat, (c) ’n lintwurm, (d) ’n spinnekop.
points: (a) Porifera
(b) Chordata
(c) Platyhelminthes
(d) Arthropoda
pointsAf: (a) Porifera
(b) Chordata
(c) Platyhelminthes
(d) Arthropoda

questions.q: Distinguish between acoelomate and coelomate animals.
questions.qAf: Onderskei tussen aselomate en selomate diere.
points: Acoelomate animals have no body cavity
coelomate animals have a fluid-filled body cavity lined by mesoderm
pointsAf: Aselomate diere het geen liggaamsholte nie
selomate diere het ’n vloeistofgevulde liggaamsholte wat met mesoderm uitgevoer is

questions.q: Give TWO advantages of bilateral symmetry.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE voordele van bilaterale simmetrie.
points: The animal has a front end and moves forward efficiently
the sense organs are at the front and face the direction of movement
pointsAf: Die dier het ’n voorkant en beweeg doeltreffend vorentoe
die sintuie is voor en wys in die bewegingsrigting

questions.q: Give TWO disadvantages of a gut with only one opening.
questions.qAf: Gee TWEE nadele van ’n spysverteringskanaal met slegs een opening.
points: Food and waste use the same opening
the gut cannot have specialised regions, and the animal cannot feed continuously
pointsAf: Voedsel en afval gebruik dieselfde opening
die spysverteringskanaal kan nie gespesialiseerde dele hê nie, en die dier kan nie aanhoudend eet nie

questions.q: Explain how some arthropods affect human health.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik hoe sommige geleedpotiges menslike gesondheid beïnvloed.
points: Some insects carry diseases, e.g. mosquitoes carry malaria
ticks and flies also spread disease-causing organisms
pointsAf: Sommige insekte dra siektes oor, bv. muskiete dra malaria oor
bosluise en vlieë versprei ook siekteveroorsakende organismes

questions.q: Define (a) assimilation and (b) egestion.
questions.qAf: Definieer (a) assimilasie en (b) egestie.
points: (a) the use of absorbed nutrients by the cells
to build new materials or release energy
(b) the removal of undigested food from the body
as faeces through the anus
pointsAf: (a) die gebruik van geabsorbeerde voedingstowwe deur die selle
om nuwe stowwe te bou of energie vry te stel
(b) die verwydering van onverteerde voedsel uit die liggaam
as feses deur die anus

questions.q: State the function of (a) incisors and (b) molars in humans.
questions.qAf: Noem die funksie van (a) snytande en (b) kiestande by mense.
points: (a) cutting and biting food
(b) grinding and chewing food
pointsAf: (a) die sny en byt van voedsel
(b) die maal en kou van voedsel

questions.q: Describe the role of the liver in keeping the blood glucose level constant.
questions.qAf: Beskryf die rol van die lewer om die bloedglukosevlak konstant te hou.
points: Excess glucose is changed into glycogen and stored in the liver
when the glucose level drops, glycogen is changed back into glucose
pointsAf: Oortollige glukose word in glikogeen verander en in die lewer gestoor
wanneer die glukosevlak daal, word glikogeen terug in glukose verander

questions.q: Name TWO diseases caused by malnutrition and give the cause of each.
questions.qAf: Noem TWEE siektes wat deur wanvoeding veroorsaak word en gee die oorsaak van elk.
points: kwashiorkor
a severe shortage of protein
marasmus (or obesity)
a shortage of energy and all nutrients (or too much energy-rich food)
pointsAf: kwashiorkor
’n ernstige tekort aan proteïen
marasmus (of vetsug)
’n tekort aan energie en alle voedingstowwe (of te veel energieryke voedsel)

questions.q: Explain why fibre is important in the diet.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom vesel belangrik in die dieet is.
points: It adds bulk to the food in the gut
which helps peristalsis and prevents constipation
pointsAf: Dit voeg massa by die voedsel in die spysverteringskanaal
wat peristalse help en hardlywigheid voorkom

questions.q: Pepsin works best at which type of pH?
questions.qAf: By watter soort pH werk pepsien die beste?
points: an acidic pH (about pH 2)
pointsAf: ’n suur pH (ongeveer pH 2)

questions.q: Name the acid secreted in the stomach.
questions.qAf: Noem die suur wat in die maag afgeskei word.
points: hydrochloric acid
pointsAf: soutsuur

questions.q: Name the end product of protein digestion.
questions.qAf: Noem die eindproduk van proteïenvertering.
points: amino acids
pointsAf: aminosure

questions.q: Describe how amino acids enter the blood.
questions.qAf: Beskryf hoe aminosure die bloed binnegaan.
points: By diffusion and active transport
through the walls of the villi into the blood capillaries
pointsAf: Deur diffusie en aktiewe transport
deur die wande van die villi in die bloedkapillêre

questions.q: Describe what happens to excess amino acids in the liver.
questions.qAf: Beskryf wat met oortollige aminosure in die lewer gebeur.
points: The amino group is removed (deamination)
and changed into urea, which is excreted by the kidneys
pointsAf: Die aminogroep word verwyder (deaminering)
en in ureum verander, wat deur die niere uitgeskei word

questions.q: Explain why pancreatic juice contains sodium hydrogen carbonate.
questions.qAf: Verduidelik waarom pankreassap natriumwaterstofkarbonaat bevat.
points: It neutralises the acid from the stomach
and provides the alkaline pH that the pancreatic enzymes need
pointsAf: Dit neutraliseer die suur uit die maag
en verskaf die alkaliese pH wat die pankreasensieme nodig het

questions.q: Name THREE products of digestion that are absorbed into the blood capillaries of the villi.
questions.qAf: Noem DRIE verteringsprodukte wat in die bloedkapillêre van die villi geabsorbeer word.
points: glucose
amino acids
vitamins, minerals or water
pointsAf: glukose
aminosure
vitamiene, minerale of water

questions.q:
Describe the light and dark phases of photosynthesis, explain how limiting factors affect its rate, and describe how farmers use this knowledge in greenhouses.
Content: 17 Synthesis: 3
NOTE: NO marks will be awarded for answers in the form of flow charts, tables or diagrams.
questions.qAf:
Beskryf die lig- en donkerfases van fotosintese, verduidelik hoe beperkende faktore die tempo daarvan beïnvloed, en beskryf hoe boere hierdie kennis in kweekhuise gebruik.
Inhoud: 17 Sintese: 3
LET WEL: GEEN punte sal toegeken word vir antwoorde in die vorm van vloeidiagramme, tabelle of diagramme nie.
points: Chlorophyll in the chloroplasts absorbs light energy
The light phase takes place in the grana (thylakoids)
Light energy splits water molecules (photolysis)
Oxygen is released as a by-product
The hydrogen is picked up by carrier molecules (NADP)
ATP is made
The dark phase (Calvin cycle) takes place in the stroma
Carbon dioxide is combined with hydrogen to form glucose
using energy from ATP
Glucose is changed into starch for storage
Light intensity can limit the rate of photosynthesis
Carbon dioxide concentration can limit the rate
Temperature limits the rate because the reactions are controlled by enzymes
The factor in the shortest supply limits the rate
Farmers use artificial lighting in greenhouses
They add carbon dioxide to the air in greenhouses
They keep the temperature at the optimum
pointsAf: Chlorofil in die chloroplaste absorbeer ligenergie
Die ligfase vind in die grana (tilakoïede) plaas
Ligenergie splits watermolekules (fotolise)
Suurstof word as ’n neweproduk vrygestel
Die waterstof word deur draermolekules (NADP) opgeneem
ATP word gemaak
Die donkerfase (Calvin-siklus) vind in die stroma plaas
Koolstofdioksied word met waterstof gekombineer om glukose te vorm
met energie uit ATP
Glukose word in stysel verander vir berging
Ligintensiteit kan die tempo van fotosintese beperk
Koolstofdioksiedkonsentrasie kan die tempo beperk
Temperatuur beperk die tempo omdat die reaksies deur ensieme beheer word
Die faktor wat die skaarsste is, beperk die tempo
Boere gebruik kunsmatige beligting in kweekhuise
Hulle voeg koolstofdioksied by die lug in kweekhuise
Hulle hou die temperatuur by die optimum

questions.q: Synthesis
questions.qAf: Sintese
points: Relevance (1): all the information is about photosynthesis, limiting factors and greenhouses; nothing irrelevant
Logical sequence (1): light phase, dark phase, limiting factors and greenhouses in a logical order
Comprehensive (1): at least 6/10 for the phases, 2/4 for limiting factors and 2/3 for greenhouses
pointsAf: Relevansie (1): al die inligting gaan oor fotosintese, beperkende faktore en kweekhuise; niks irrelevant nie
Logiese volgorde (1): ligfase, donkerfase, beperkende faktore en kweekhuise in ’n logiese volgorde
Omvattend (1): ten minste 6/10 vir die fases, 2/4 vir beperkende faktore en 2/3 vir kweekhuise
